summary.en: The South Pacific island nation of Fiji has declared a nationwide state of disaster as it battles a rare prolonged drought and a severe water shortage. Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabuka said the declaration allows the government to centrally deploy emergency teams, relief supplies and public resources, and that special relief funds have been set aside for emergency water supply, help for affected communities, and relief for agriculture and livestock. Authorities warn that 75 per cent of water sources will be at warning level by the end of November, and the figure could exceed 82 per cent by next January, leaving more than 80 per cent of the country's water supply at risk of running dry.
summary.zh_hans: 南太平洋岛国斐济遭遇罕见持续干旱，当地星期三宣布全国进入灾难状态，全力应对严峻缺水危机。斐济总理兰布卡表示，灾难状态启动后，政府将有权统一调配应急队伍、救灾物资及各类公共资源，当局已拨出专项救灾资金，用于应急供水保障、受灾社区帮扶、农业养殖救济及干旱衍生灾害处置等工作。斐济当局警告，当地11月底警戒级缺水水源占比将攀升至75%，到明年1月这个比例可能突破82%，届时全国超过八成供水水源将面临枯竭危机。
summary.zh_hant: 南太平洋島國斐濟遭遇罕見持續乾旱，當地星期三宣布全國進入災難狀態，全力應對嚴峻缺水危機。斐濟總理蘭布卡表示，災難狀態啟動後，政府將有權統一調配應急隊伍、救災物資及各類公共資源，當局已撥出專項救災資金，用於應急供水保障、受災社區幫扶、農業養殖救濟及乾旱衍生災害處置等工作。斐濟當局警告，當地11月底警戒級缺水水源佔比將攀升至75%，到明年1月呢個比例可能突破82%，屆時全國超過八成供水水源將面臨枯竭危機。

summary.en: The opening ceremonies for Business of Design Week 2026 and DesignInspire were held on November 18, launching four major design events running in Hong Kong until November 29, including the city programme DESIGN@HKG 2026 and the deTour 2026 Design Festival. DesignInspire, organised by the Trade Development Council, runs until November 21 with more than 200 exhibitors from 17 countries and regions under the theme "Wander & Wonder". The Hong Kong Design Centre also hosted "Vividly Hong Kong" at the DX design hub on the same evening to mark its second anniversary and the opening of seven new exhibitions.
summary.zh_hans: 设计营商周2026与DesignInspire的开幕典礼于11月18日举行，连同全城节目DESIGN@HKG 2026及deTour 2026设计节，四大设计盛事即日起至11月29日在香港先后或同期举行。由贸发局主办的DesignInspire即日起至11月21日举行，主题为“Wander & Wonder”，汇聚17个国家及地区逾200家参展商。香港设计中心当晚亦在DX设计枢纽举办“Vividly Hong Kong”，庆祝DX设计枢纽成立两周年及七个新展览开幕。
summary.zh_hant: 設計營商周2026同DesignInspire嘅開幕典禮喺11月18日舉行，連同全城節目DESIGN@HKG 2026及deTour 2026設計節，四大設計盛事即日起至11月29號喺香港先後或同期舉行。由貿發局主辦嘅DesignInspire即日起至11月21號舉行，主題係「Wander & Wonder」，匯聚17個國家及地區逾200家參展商。香港設計中心同晚亦喺DX設計樞紐舉辦「Vividly Hong Kong」，慶祝DX設計樞紐成立兩周年及七個新展覽開幕。

summary.en: The Chief Executive's Office said one of its vehicles was turning slowly from Gloucester Road into Fenwick Street in Wan Chai at about 5:48 pm when a pedestrian suddenly dashed across the road where there was no pedestrian crossing. The driver braked in time and called police. Police confirmed the pedestrian had crossed the road illegally, and the pedestrian declined to go to hospital for further checks. The incident was recorded.
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官办公室表示，一辆特首办车辆昨日下午约5时48分，在湾仔告士打道慢驶左转入分域街时，一名途人在没有行人过路设施的路段突然冲出马路，司机及时刹停车辆并即场报警。警方到场后确认涉事途人违规横过马路，该途人拒绝到医院接受进一步检查，事件作备案处理。
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官辦公室表示，一輛特首辦車輛昨日下午約5時48分，喺灣仔告士打道慢駛左轉入分域街嗰陣，一名途人喺冇行人過路設施嘅路段突然衝出馬路，司機及時煞停車輛並即場報警。警方到場後確認涉事途人違規橫過馬路，該途人拒絕去醫院接受進一步檢查，事件作備案處理。

title.en: Chief Executive's Office Vehicle Brakes in Time as Pedestrian Dashes Across Wan Chai Road; Police Confirm Jaywalking

summary.en: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said inflation is still heading in the wrong direction and spreading, and the Fed should act more aggressively, including considering a half-point rate rise in December or clearly signalling faster hikes next year. He said the recent annualised inflation rate has exceeded 3 per cent and may be accelerating, driven mainly by services, and warned that if company managers treat it as normal and pass it on to consumers, it will become harder to contain. Waller said the market needs to understand that 3 per cent inflation is not the Fed's target, and expectations of only one quarter-point rise should be overturned.
summary.zh_hans: 美国联储局理事沃勒表示，通胀仍在朝错误的方向发展，而且正在蔓延，联储局应采取更进取的措施应对，包括考虑在12月加息半厘，或者明确表达明年将加快加息步伐。沃勒接受外电访问时表示，近期的年化通胀率已超过3%，并可能正在加速，而且价格升势主要受服务业影响，认为与高油价及其他短暂性因素影响有限，忧虑企业管理层会视之为常态，并转嫁予消费者，到时要压抑通胀就会变得困难。他又说，市场对当前价格水平的接受程度超出预期，有需要让市场意识到3%的通胀率并非当局的目标水平，并推翻市场对于联储局只会加息1次、加幅只有0.25厘的预期。
summary.zh_hant: 美國聯儲局理事沃勒表示，通脹仍在朝錯誤嘅方向發展，而且正在蔓延，聯儲局應採取更進取嘅措施應對，包括考慮喺12月加息半厘，或者明確表達明年將加快加息步伐。沃勒接受外電訪問時表示，近期嘅年化通脹率已超過3%，並可能正在加速，而且價格升勢主要受服務業影響，認為與高油價及其他短暫性因素影響有限，憂慮企業管理層會視之為常態，並轉嫁予消費者，到時要壓抑通脹就會變得困難。佢又話，市場對當前價格水平嘅接受程度超出預期，有需要令市場意識到3%嘅通脹率並非當局嘅目標水平，並推翻市場對於聯儲局只會加息1次、加幅只有0.25厘嘅預期。

title.en: Fed's Waller Urges Consideration of Half-Point December Hike as Inflation Tops 3% and Heads the Wrong Way

summary.en: Two public toilets managed by the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department have won gold and bronze awards in this year's Hong Kong's Best Public Toilet Award. The gold winner, the Lei Yue Mun (Ling Nam Sun Tsuen) Public Toilet in Kwun Tong, uses the winning design from the PT 2.0 Public Toilet Design Competition, with a modular structure, accessible toilets with automatic doors, real-time odour monitoring and a smart accident detection system. The bronze winner is the refurbished Aberdeen Main Road Public Toilet in Southern District. The department manages more than 800 public toilets, and refurbishment works have been rolled out for nearly 85 per cent of those covered by its enhancement programme.
summary.zh_hans: 食环署管理的两个公厕在今年香港最佳公厕选举中夺得金奖及铜奖。金奖得主是观塘鲤鱼门（岭南新村）公厕，采用“公厕2.0”设计比赛优胜概念，模组式结构可灵活配合不同地形，设有自动门无障碍厕所、实时气味监测系统及智能意外侦测系统。铜奖得主是翻新后的南区香港仔大道公厕。食环署现管理逾800个公厕，优化翻新计划覆盖的公厕中，近85%已展开工程。
summary.zh_hant: 食環署管理嘅兩個公廁喺今年香港最佳公廁選舉中奪得金獎及銅獎。金獎得主係觀塘鯉魚門（嶺南新村）公廁，採用「公廁2.0」設計比賽優勝概念，模組式結構可以靈活配合唔同地形，設有自動門無障礙廁所、實時氣味監測系統及智能意外偵測系統。銅獎得主係翻新後嘅南區香港仔大道公廁。食環署現時管理逾800個公廁，優化翻新計劃覆蓋嘅公廁當中，近85%已經展開工程。

summary.en: US housing starts rebounded in October, rising 9.9 per cent month on month to an annualised 1.309 million units, beating market expectations of 1.245 million and up 2.8 per cent from a year earlier, after a 7 per cent fall in September. Building permits told a different story, however, falling 7.4 per cent to an annualised 1.295 million units, below the expected 1.377 million and down 8.7 per cent year on year.

summary.en: Police have broken up an online shopping fraud ring selling electronic gift cards, involving at least 35 cases in which victims lost more than HK$650,000. Eleven people were arrested. The group used large numbers of real-name registered SIM cards to open shopping platform accounts and advertised gift cards at 10 to 20 per cent below market price, luring victims to transfer money to bank accounts controlled by the group before issuing invalid redemption codes. The seven men and four women arrested are aged 19 to 74 and include the suspected ringleader, the registrants of the phone numbers and platform accounts, and the bank account holders.
summary.zh_hans: 警方瓦解一个涉及电子产品礼品卡的网购骗案集团，涉及至少35宗同类骗案，受害人共损失超过65万元，7男4女被捕。警方表示，诈骗集团收取大量已实名登记的电话卡，用作开设网购平台账户，以低于市价10%至20%的价钱刊登放售电子产品礼品卡，诱使受害人转账至集团操控的银行户口，其后向受害人提供无效兑换码。被捕的7男4女年龄介乎19至74岁，包括集团主脑、电话号码及网上购物平台户口登记人，以及银行户口持有人等。
summary.zh_hant: 警方瓦解一個涉及電子產品禮品卡嘅網購騙案集團，涉及至少35宗同類騙案，受害人共損失超過65萬元，7男4女被捕。警方表示，詐騙集團收取大量已實名登記嘅電話卡，用作開設網購平台帳戶，以低於市價10%至20%嘅價錢刊登放售電子產品禮品卡，誘使受害人轉帳至集團操控嘅銀行戶口，其後向受害人提供無效兌換碼。被捕嘅7男4女年齡介乎19至74歲，包括集團主腦、電話號碼及網上購物平台戶口登記人，以及銀行戶口持有人等。

summary.en: China and South Korea have substantively concluded the second phase of negotiations on their free trade agreement, the Ministry of Commerce said. The talks, guided by the consensus reached by the two countries' leaders, took more than eight years. The upgrade covers the investment, services trade, financial services and economic cooperation chapters of the original agreement, raising the level of investment and services liberalisation and facilitation, and adopts a negative-list model for opening commitments in investment, cross-border services trade and financial services, setting transparent, stable and predictable market-access rules for two-way investment and services trade. The two sides also agreed on implementation arrangements for economic cooperation, including traditional medicine services, cultural cooperation and internet services.
summary.zh_hans: 商务部表示，中韩双方以两国元首重要共识为指引，推进中韩自贸协定第二阶段谈判，历经8年多时间，在近日实质性完成，达成互利共赢的高水平谈判成果。中韩自贸协定第二阶段对原中韩自贸协定投资、服务贸易、金融服务和经济合作章及有关附件进行升级，进一步提升了双方投资和服务自由化、便利化规则水平，并采用负面清单模式针对投资、跨境服务贸易、金融服务等领域作出开放承诺，为后续双向投资和服务贸易往来建立了透明、稳定、可预期的准入规则。另外，双方又制定了经济合作领域具体实施安排，涵盖传统医学服务合作、文化合作和网络服务合作等内容。
summary.zh_hant: 商務部表示，中韓雙方以兩國元首重要共識為指引，推進中韓自貿協定第二階段談判，歷經8年幾時間，喺近日實質性完成，達成互利共贏嘅高水平談判成果。中韓自貿協定第二階段對原中韓自貿協定投資、服務貿易、金融服務同經濟合作章及有關附件進行升級，進一步提升咗雙方投資同服務自由化、便利化規則水平，並採用負面清單模式針對投資、跨境服務貿易、金融服務等領域作出開放承諾，為後續雙向投資同服務貿易往來建立透明、穩定、可預期嘅准入規則。另外，雙方又制定咗經濟合作領域具體實施安排，涵蓋傳統醫學服務合作、文化合作同網絡服務合作等內容。

title.en: China and South Korea Substantively Conclude Second-Phase FTA Talks After Eight Years; Negative-List Opening for Investment and Services

summary.en: A first-alarm fire broke out in the evening in a flat in Chim Uk Tsuen, Shuen Wan, Tai Po. A woman who inhaled smoke felt unwell and was taken to hospital conscious after first aid from paramedics. The Fire Services Department received the report at 5:59 pm, arrived four minutes later, and had the fire largely under control by 6:18 pm with one hose jet and one breathing apparatus team. About 20 residents evacuated on their own, and firefighters rescued two dogs and a cat from the flat. The fire is believed to have started in the living room, possibly from an electrical short circuit, and is not thought to be suspicious.
summary.zh_hans: 大埔船湾詹屋村一个单位傍晚发生一级火警，一名女子吸入浓烟不适，经救护员初步治理后清醒送院。消防处在下午5时59分接报，4分钟后到达现场，动用一条喉和一队烟帽队灌救，火势于晚上6时18分大致被救熄。期间约20名居民自行疏散，消防员在起火单位救出两只狗及一只猫。调查相信火警起因没有可疑，起火位置为涉事单位的客厅，怀疑因电器短路引致。
summary.zh_hant: 大埔船灣詹屋村一個單位傍晚發生一級火警，一名女子吸入濃煙不適，經救護員初步治理後清醒送院。消防處喺下午5時59分接報，4分鐘後到達現場，動用一條喉同一隊煙帽隊灌救，火勢喺晚上6時18分大致被救熄。期間約20名居民自行疏散，消防員喺起火單位救出兩隻狗同一隻貓。調查相信火警起因冇可疑，起火位置係涉事單位嘅客廳，懷疑因電器短路引致。

title.en: Tai Po Village Flat Fire Sends Woman to Hospital; Firefighters Rescue Two Dogs and a Cat as Short Circuit Suspected

summary.en: The Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism, Rosanna Law, officiated at the opening ceremony of Hong Kong Winter Wonderland in Central on November 18, kicking off the Hong Kong WinterFest organised by the Tourism Board. Building on last year's successful debut, the experience expands this year to Tsim Sha Tsui and Causeway Bay, each with its own themed light show, while the facades of several iconic Central landmarks will be illuminated from tonight until early January. Tonight also marks the grand finale of "A Symphony of Lights", which has run for 22 years and was recognised by Guinness World Records in 2005 as the world's largest permanent light and sound show, closing with a rooftop pyrotechnics display.
summary.zh_hans: 文化体育及旅游局局长罗淑佩11月18日晚上为中环“香港冬日嘉年华”开幕典礼致辞，为旅发局主办的香港冬日节揭开序幕。继去年首度推出大受欢迎，今届冬日嘉年华由中环扩展至尖沙咀和铜锣湾，三区各有不同主题灯光秀，中环多座地标建筑物外墙由今晚起亮灯，直至明年1月初。今晚亦是陪伴港人22年的“幻彩咏香江”告别演出，该汇演在2005年获吉尼斯世界纪录认证为全球最大型永久灯光音乐汇演，今晚将以天台烟花表演作结。
summary.zh_hant: 文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩11月18日晚上為中環「香港冬日嘉年華」開幕典禮致辭，為旅發局主辦嘅香港冬日節揭開序幕。繼上年首度推出大受歡迎，今屆冬日嘉年華由中環擴展至尖沙咀同銅鑼灣，三區各有唔同主題燈光騷，中環多座地標建築物外牆由今晚起亮燈，直至明年1月初。今晚亦係陪伴港人22年嘅「幻彩詠香江」告別演出，呢個匯演喺2005年獲健力士世界紀錄認證為全球最大型永久燈光音樂匯演，今晚將以天台煙火表演作結。

summary.en: The onshore yuan closed at a more than half-month high against the US dollar, finishing at 6.6653 per dollar, up 2 pips. The daily fixing has risen for five straight sessions to a near four-and-a-half-year high, coming in about 460 pips weaker than the market had forecast. Market watchers expect limited yuan movement ahead of the meeting of the Chinese, US and Russian leaders, while HSBC said persistent dollar strength and weak mainland economic fundamentals are holding back the yuan's rise, expecting it to hold near 6.65 per dollar by year-end with scope for mild appreciation next year.
summary.zh_hans: 在岸人民币兑美元收市创逾半个月新高，收报6.6653兑1美元，微升2点子。中间价连升5个交易日，创近4年半新高，较市场预测偏弱约460点子。市场人士认为，中美俄元首会晤在即，预计人民币变动有限。汇丰认为，近期美元持续走强，加上内地经济基本面偏弱，抑制人民币升势，预计人民币年底可能维持在6.65兑1美元水平附近，明年有望继续温和升值。
summary.zh_hant: 在岸人民幣兌美元收市創逾半個月新高，收報6.6653兌1美元，微升2點子。中間價連升5個交易日，創近4年半新高，較市場預測偏弱約460點子。市場人士認為，中美俄元首會晤在即，預計人民幣變動有限。滙豐認為，近期美元持續走強，加上內地經濟基本面偏弱，抑制人民幣升勢，預計人民幣年底可能維持喺6.65兌1美元水平附近，明年有望繼續溫和升值。

title.en: Onshore Yuan Closes at Over Half-Month High of 6.6653; Fixing Rises for a Fifth Day to Near Four-and-a-Half-Year Peak

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks fell for a second straight day. The Hang Seng Index dropped as much as 300 points intraday before closing at 23,294, down 213 points or 0.91 per cent, with main-board turnover of nearly HK$177.2 billion. The tech index closed at 3,736, down 0.6 per cent, with all ATMXJ stocks lower. JD.com shares fell more than 7 per cent and JD Health plunged more than 15 per cent after results, the worst performers among Hang Seng and tech index constituents, while JD Logistics fell more than 2 per cent and JD Industrials rose nearly 6 per cent against the trend. Lenovo rose more than 4 per cent, the best blue chip, and carmakers mostly gained, with Nio and XPeng up more than 2 to 3 per cent.
summary.zh_hans: 港股连跌2日。恒生指数最多曾跌300点，收市报23294点，跌213点，跌幅0.91%，主板成交额近1772亿元。科技指数收报3736点，跌0.6%。ATMXJ全线向下，京东系部分股份公布业绩后大幅下挫，京东集团低收逾7%，京东健康急跌逾15%，是表现最差两只恒指及科指成份股；京东物流跌逾2%，京东工业逆市升近6%。科网、网上医疗平台、医药、资源股大多受压。金融股亦向下，重磅股友邦及汇控跌近1%至近2%。联想集团逆市升逾4%，是表现最好蓝筹股，汽车股大多造好，蔚来及小鹏升逾2%至逾3%。
summary.zh_hant: 港股連跌2日。恒生指數最多曾跌300點，收市報23294點，跌213點，跌幅0.91%，主板成交額近1772億元。科技指數收報3736點，跌0.6%。ATMXJ全線向下，京東系部分股份公布業績後大幅下挫，京東集團低收逾7%，京東健康急跌逾15%，係表現最差兩隻恒指及科指成份股；京東物流跌逾2%，京東工業逆市升近6%。科網、網上醫療平台、醫藥、資源股大多受壓。金融股亦向下，重磅股友邦及滙控跌近1%至近2%。聯想集團逆市升逾4%，係表現最好藍籌股，汽車股大多造好，蔚來及小鵬升逾2%至逾3%。

title.en: Hang Seng Closes Down 213 Points for a Second Straight Fall; JD Health Plunges Over 15% After Results as Worst Blue Chip

summary.en: TVB has invited Andy Hui to be the finale guest at its anniversary gala, "TVM Gala 2026", airing live on November 19, where he will perform a medley of classic hits with a live band. Attention has focused on whether Hui may cross paths with Kenneth Ma, who is taking part in the opening song-and-dance segment, in what would be their first time at the same event seven years after the 2019 "On Sum" scandal, when the married Hui was caught kissing Jacqueline Wong, then Ma's girlfriend, in a taxi. Hui's 33-year career stalled after he admitted he was a "broken man", but he returned to the Hong Kong Coliseum in October with three well-received concerts. Ma has said he forgave both of them long ago and bears no grudge, though many netizens have rallied behind him online, with some urging him to skip the gala to avoid an awkward scene.
summary.zh_hans: 无线公布，许志安将担任明晚（19日）举行的《万千星辉贺台庆》压轴表演嘉宾，在现场乐队伴奏下献唱经典金曲Medley。外界焦点落在他可能会与有份参与序幕歌舞环节的马国明相遇，正是2019年“安心事件”7年后，二人将首度同场，引发热议。2019年，已婚的许志安被揭发与当时正与马国明拍拖的黄心颖在的士车厢内激吻，事件震撼全城。许志安自认“坏了的人”，其长达33年的演艺事业随即停摆；经过7年沉淀，他于今年10月重踏红馆舞台，连开3场演唱会并获外界高度评价。马国明曾公开表示早已原谅二人，从未对两人心存怨恨，但大批网民仍为马国明抱不平，在网上留言质疑电视台是否尊重他，甚至揣测他会否缺席明晚盛会。
summary.zh_hant: 無綫公布，許志安將擔任明晚（19日）舉行嘅《萬千星輝賀台慶》壓軸表演嘉賓，喺現場樂隊伴奏下獻唱經典金曲Medley。外界焦點落喺佢可能會同有份參與序幕歌舞環節嘅馬國明相遇，正係2019年「安心事件」7年後，兩人將首度同場，引發熱議。2019年，已婚嘅許志安被揭發同當時正與馬國明拍拖嘅黃心穎喺的士車廂內激吻，事件震撼全城。許志安自認「壞咗的人」，其長達33年嘅演藝事業隨即停擺；經過7年沉澱，佢喺今年10月重踏紅館舞台，連開3場演唱會並獲外界高度評價。馬國明曾公開表示早已原諒二人，從未對兩人心存怨恨，但大批網民仍為馬國明抱不平，喺網上留言質疑電視台係咪尊重佢，甚至揣測佢會唔會缺席明晚盛會。

title.en: Andy Hui to Close TVB Anniversary Gala as Kenneth Ma Opens It; First Shared Stage in Seven Years Since 'On Sum' Scandal
